measures.name: paid_order_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then 1 else 0 end

measures.name: valid_order_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then 1 else 0 end

measures.name: cancelled_order_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'cancelled' then 1 else 0 end

measures.name: refund_order_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then 1 else 0 end

measures.name: partial_refund_order_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 and refund_cents < paid_cents then 1 else 0 end

measures.name: full_refund_order_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents > 0 and refund_cents = paid_cents then 1 else 0 end

measures.name: payment_cents_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents else 0 end

measures.name: refund_cents_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then refund_cents else 0 end

measures.name: net_sales_cents_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end

measures.name: gross_cents_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end

measures.name: discount_cents_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents - paid_cents else 0 end

measures.name: buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id else null end

measures.name: refund_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then member_id else null end

measures.name: selling_store_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then store_id else null end

measures.name: valid_order_items_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then quantity else 0 end

measures.name: first_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: case when order_seq = 1 then member_id else null end

measures.name: first_order_sales_cents_measure
measures.expr: case when order_seq = 1 then net_cents else 0 end

measures.name: first_order_count_measure
measures.expr: case when order_seq = 1 then 1 else 0 end

measures.name: repeat_order_count_measure
measures.expr: case when order_seq >= 2 then 1 else 0 end

measures.name: monthly_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: case when valid_orders >= 1 then member_id else null end

measures.name: monthly_repeat_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: case when valid_orders >= 2 then member_id else null end

measures.name: monthly_paid_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: case when is_paid_qualified = 1 and valid_orders >= 1 then member_id else null end

measures.name: monthly_paid_order_count_measure
measures.expr: case when is_paid_qualified = 1 then valid_orders else 0 end

measures.name: monthly_paid_sales_cents_measure
measures.expr: case when is_paid_qualified = 1 then net_cents else 0 end

measures.name: monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: case when is_paid_qualified = 1 and valid_orders >= 2 then member_id else null end

metrics.name: order_count
metrics.label: 创建订单数
metrics.description: 按下单日期统计全部订单，每个订单号一次，包含取消单。

metrics.name: paid_order_count
metrics.label: 支付订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 的订单数，包括后来全部退款的订单。

metrics.name: valid_order_count
metrics.label: 有效订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 且实付金额减退款金额大于零的订单数；取消和全退不计。

metrics.name: cancelled_order_count
metrics.label: 取消订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 cancelled 的订单数。

metrics.name: refund_order_count
metrics.label: 退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款金额大于零的订单数，包括部分退款与全部退款。

metrics.name: partial_refund_order_count
metrics.label: 部分退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款大于零、小于实付金额的订单数。

metrics.name: full_refund_order_count
metrics.label: 全额退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且实付大于零、退款等于实付的订单数。

metrics.name: payment_cents
metrics.label: 实付金额
metrics.description: paid 订单实付金额合计，尚未扣退款；单位分。

metrics.name: refund_cents
metrics.label: 退款金额
metrics.description: paid 订单退款金额合计，按原订单下单日期归属，不是现金退款发生日；单位分。

metrics.name: net_sales_cents
metrics.label: 净销售额
metrics.description: paid 订单实付减退款后合计；取消单不计；按原订单下单日期归属；单位分。

metrics.name: gross_cents
metrics.label: 支付订单原价金额
metrics.description: paid 订单折扣前原价金额合计；单位分。

metrics.name: discount_cents
metrics.label: 优惠金额
metrics.description: paid 订单原价减实付的金额合计；退款不冲减原优惠金额；单位分。

metrics.name: buyer_count
metrics.label: 购买会员数
metrics.description: 统计窗口及筛选条件内有有效订单的不同 CRM 会员账户数，不做跨系统自然人去重。

metrics.name: refund_buyer_count
metrics.label: 退款会员数
metrics.description: 统计窗口内发生退款的 paid 订单关联的不同 CRM 会员账户数。

metrics.name: selling_store_count
metrics.label: 成交门店数
metrics.description: 窗口内至少有一笔有效订单的不同订单归属门店数。

metrics.name: valid_order_items
metrics.label: 有效订单商品件数
metrics.description: 有效订单中的原始购买件数合计；退款金额不能推算退货件数，此项不是净商品销量。

metrics.name: avg_order_value
metrics.label: 有效订单均额
metrics.description: 净销售额除以有效订单数，单位分／单；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: avg_buyer_value
metrics.label: 购买会员人均消费
metrics.description: 净销售额除以购买会员数，单位分／账户；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: purchase_frequency
metrics.label: 购买频次
metrics.description: 有效订单数除以购买会员数，单位单／账户；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: refund_amount_rate
metrics.label: 退款金额占比
metrics.description: 退款金额除以实付金额；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: cancel_rate
metrics.label: 取消率
metrics.description: 取消订单数除以创建订单数；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: refund_order_rate
metrics.label: 退款订单率
metrics.description: 退款订单数除以支付订单数；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: discount_rate
metrics.label: 优惠率
metrics.description: 优惠金额除以支付订单原价金额；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: items_per_order
metrics.label: 单均商品件数
metrics.description: 有效订单商品件数除以有效订单数；分母零时未定义。

metrics.name: new_member_count
metrics.label: 注册会员数
metrics.description: 按注册日期统计新注册 CRM 账户数；可按归属门店和会员等级分组，不等于自然人数。

metrics.name: first_buyer_count
metrics.label: 观测期首购会员数
metrics.description: 在测试覆盖期内首次有效订单落入查询窗口的不同 CRM 账户数；不代表终身首购。先用全覆盖历史确定首次，再按窗口筛选。

metrics.name: first_order_sales_cents
metrics.label: 观测期首单净销售额
metrics.description: 每个账户在测试覆盖期内第一笔有效订单的净销售额，按该单日期归属；相同日期按订单号排序；单位分。

metrics.name: first_order_count
metrics.label: 观测期首单数
metrics.description: 在全测试覆盖期内先为每个账户按日期、订单号排序，其第一笔有效订单落入窗口的单数。

metrics.name: repeat_order_count
metrics.label: 观测期后续购买订单数
metrics.description: 账户全测试覆盖期内第二笔及以后的有效订单，按订单日期落入窗口计数。不是月内复购人数。

metrics.name: monthly_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月内购买会员数
metrics.description: 同一自然月有至少一笔有效订单的账户数，仅整月、全门店口径；允许连续整月按月分别展示，不能跨月直接加总当人数。

metrics.name: monthly_repeat_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月内复购会员数
metrics.description: 同一自然月有至少两笔有效订单的账户数，仅整月、全门店口径；不能由全量订单行上的简单条件代替。

metrics.name: monthly_repeat_rate
metrics.label: 月内复购率
metrics.description: 同一自然月的月内复购会员数除以月内购买会员数，仅整月、全门店口径；分母零时未定义；跨多月查询必须按月展示。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月末付费会员购买人数
metrics.description: 自然月内有至少一笔有效订单、且月末符合总部运营月报付费资格的不同账户数（本期暂定口径）。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_order_count
metrics.label: 月末付费会员有效订单数
metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格的账户在该自然月的全部有效订单数，按账户资格筛选，不按卡重复（本期暂定口径）。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_sales_cents
metrics.label: 月末付费会员净销售额
metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格的账户在该自然月的有效订单净销售额合计，单位分（本期暂定口径）。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
metrics.label: 月末付费会员复购人数
metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格，且同一自然月至少有两笔有效订单的不同账户数（本期暂定口径）。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_repeat_rate
metrics.label: 月末付费会员复购率
metrics.description: 月末付费会员复购人数除以月末付费会员购买人数；分母为零时未定义（本期暂定口径）。

metrics.name: monthly_paid_avg_order_value
metrics.label: 月末付费会员订单均额
metrics.description: 月末付费会员净销售额除以月末付费会员有效订单数；单位分／单，分母零时未定义（本期暂定口径）。

model_sql.ranked_valid_orders:
SELECT
  order_id,
  member_id,
  store_id,
  ordered_at,
  channel,
  paid_cents - refund_cents AS net_cents,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY member_id
    ORDER BY ordered_at ASC, order_id ASC
  ) AS order_seq
FROM {{ ref('orders') }}
WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0
model_sql.member_monthly_orders:
WITH month_spine AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    date_trunc('month', date_day)::DATE AS month_start,
    (date_trunc('month', date_day) + INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE AS month_end
  FROM {{ ref('time_spine') }}
),
member_orders AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    date_trunc('month', ordered_at)::DATE AS month_start,
    COUNT(order_id) AS valid_orders,
    SUM(paid_cents - refund_cents) AS net_cents
  FROM {{ ref('orders') }}
  WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0
  GROUP BY member_id, date_trunc('month', ordered_at)::DATE
),
active_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_id, month_start FROM member_orders
  UNION
  SELECT c.member_id, ms.month_start
  FROM {{ ref('cards') }} c
  CROSS JOIN month_spine ms
  WHERE c.card_type IN ('悦享年卡', '家庭季卡')
    AND c.valid_from <= ms.month_end
    AND c.valid_until > ms.month_end
    AND (c.ended_at IS NULL OR c.ended_at > ms.month_end)
),
member_qualification AS (
  SELECT
    am.member_id,
    am.month_start,
    ms.month_end,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM {{ ref('cards') }} c
      WHERE c.member_id = am.member_id
        AND c.card_type IN ('悦享年卡', '家庭季卡')
        AND c.valid_from <= ms.month_end
        AND c.valid_until > ms.month_end
        AND (c.ended_at IS NULL OR c.ended_at > ms.month_end)
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_paid_qualified
  FROM active_members am
  JOIN month_spine ms ON am.month_start = ms.month_start
)
SELECT
  mq.member_id || '_' || strftime(mq.month_start, '%Y-%m-%d') AS member_month_id,
  mq.member_id,
  mq.month_start,
  mq.is_paid_qualified,
  COALESCE(mo.valid_orders, 0) AS valid_orders,
  COALESCE(mo.net_cents, 0) AS net_cents
FROM member_qualification mq
LEFT JOIN member_orders mo
  ON mq.member_id = mo.member_id AND mq.month_start = mo.month_start

business_model_usage.quote: 在测试库中，订单和会员卡均关联 CRM 会员账户，账户与订单、账户与卡分别是一对多关系。
本期交付内容明确不含会员筛选（圈选），避免验收时算进本期。
本期总部运营月报付费会员仅包含：悦享年卡、家庭季卡。
在计算有资格账户时只算一个有资格账户，不重复算人、不重复累计订单。
该卡种范围仅约束本期总部运营月报，不改其他报表；当前为运营口头答复，待运营出具书面确认
核实前不能当作门店归属；本期统计不改变现有考核，也不代表门店执行已经改善；若涉及展示，必须注明上述限制。
本期注册会员数按等级分组展示，运营同意按“账户当前登记等级”统计，并在回答中注明“按账户当前等级，不是注册当时的等级”
